esoterica.mnemonic: esoterica – ESO (inner) circle hi samajhta hai

echolalia.definition: automatic repetition of words spoken by others
echolalia.ex: The child with autism showed signs of echolalia.
echolalia.mnemonic: echolalia – echo jaisa 'la la' dohrata rehna

expunge.ex: The court ordered the police to expunge his arrest record.
expunge.mnemonic: expunge – ex-boss ne punch maar ke record se naam mita diya

eudaimonia.definition: human flourishing; happiness through virtuous living
eudaimonia.ex: Aristotle saw eudaimonia as life's highest goal.
eudaimonia.mnemonic: eudaimonia – 'eu' good + daimon spirit, achhi zindagi ki khushi

embarrass.definition: cause someone to feel awkward or ashamed
embarrass.ex: Don't embarrass me in front of guests.
embarrass.mnemonic: embarrass – sabke saamne sharminda kar diya

encraoch.definition: to spread into someone's area (spelling mistake)
encraoch.ex: The neighbours tried to encraoch on their land.

exprimant.definition: not a real word - likely means expresser
exprimant.ex: This word is not correct, please check spelling.

extacted.ex: Correct spelling is 'extracted' - the dentist extracted the tooth.

effectively.definition: in a way that produces the intended result
effectively.ex: She effectively managed the entire project alone.
effectively.mnemonic: effect ka kaam – jo asar se kaam kare, effectively

exagerate.definition: wrong spelling, means to make bigger than real
exagerate.bn: বানান ভুল, exaggerate এর ভুল বানান
exagerate.ex: 'Exagerate' is wrong — correct spelling is exaggerate.

exestenalism.definition: philosophy that only real things exist
exestenalism.ex: His exestenalism belief says only what we see is real.

ettiquete.ex: The teacher corrected 'ettiquete' on the board.

enterpreneur.ex: Rahul wrote enterpreneur instead of entrepreneur.

electrophoresis.definition: movement of particles by electric field
electrophoresis.ex: DNA was separated using gel electrophoresis.

egalitarianism.definition: belief in equal rights for all people
egalitarianism.ex: Her politics were rooted in egalitarianism and fairness.
egalitarianism.mnemonic: egalitarian – 'equal' logo ka -tarian group, sab barabar

epistemology.ex: Epistemology asks how we know what we know.
epistemology.mnemonic: epistem – gyaan ki study, hum kaise jaante hain

eleemosynary.definition: relating to or dependent on charity
eleemosynary.ex: The eleemosynary institution survives on public donations.
eleemosynary.mnemonic: eleemosynary – alms doing 'money' donate karne wala charity kaam

existence.definition: the state of being or living
existence.ex: They questioned the existence of alien life.

embarass.ex: Don't write 'embarass', it is wrongly spelled.

experiance.ex: Please do not write 'experiance' in your English exam.

embarrassment.ex: He blushed with embarrassment at the mistake.
embarrassment.mnemonic: embarrassment – bar (rukawat) se sabke saamne sharminda

explored.ex: They explored the caves for hidden passages.
explored.mnemonic: ex-plor – bahar nikal ke khoja, nayi jagah explored

expect.ex: We expect good results next quarter.

emerged.ex: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
emerged.mnemonic: emerge – 'e' bahar + merge, paani se bahar aana

endengered.definition: animals or plants in danger of dying out
endengered.ex: The Indian rhino is an endangered animal.

eficcient.definition: wrong spelling of efficient, not a real word
eficcient.ex: Rahul wrote 'eficcient' wrongly in his English exam.

entertenment.ex: Sita wrote entertenment wrongly in her essay.

explaination.ex: 'Explaination' is not a correct English word.

except.mnemonic: except – 'ex-cept', bahar rakh ke le liya, chhodkar

excerpt.definition: a short extract from a text
excerpt.ex: She read an excerpt from her new novel.
excerpt.mnemonic: excerpt – ex (bahar) + pluck, book se ek tukda nikaala

err.definition: to make a mistake; be wrong
err.mnemonic: err – 'arre' galti ho gayi, mistake kar di

ere.ex: We must leave ere dawn breaks.
ere.mnemonic: ere – 'e-re' pehle hi bol diya, before
